The patient then underwent tumor resection using the occipital interhemispheric approach. During the operation, the majority of the tumor base was located at the falx end and the tentorium. The tumor was removed in a piecemeal fashion. Finally, the tumor and the base were totally removed (Simpson grade I resection).
